entities.summary: Hrvoje Hitrec is a Croatian writer, screenwriter, and politician. He is notable for his works for children and youth, most famous of his works being the novel Smogovci [hr], but Hitrec also wrote novels, film and TV scripts, dramas. He received several notable Croatian literary awards: "Ksaver Šandor Gjalski," "Ivana Brlić Mažuranić" and "Grigor Vitez."
